subjects.title: Cultural Activities: Study of Folk Songs, Folk Theatre, and Folk Traditions

units.title: Suggested Activities
units.topics: 1. Study of at least one regional folk song, dance, or theatre form. 2. Field visits or virtual interaction with folk artists/community practitioners. 3. Audio/video documentation of a folk performance (where feasible). 4. Written report on the history and cultural context of the chosen tradition. 5. Lyric/story analysis of a folk song or folk theatre narrative. 6. Comparative study of two folk traditions from different regions. 7. Presentation or demonstration (live or recorded) of a folk form. 8. Interview-based assignment with a folk practitioner. 9. Reflection on challenges faced by folk artists today. 10. Creative reinterpretation of a folk form (respecting authenticity). 11. Portfolio submission (optional).
